changes: No changes to envelope fields or deflate format. No cache/base/delta.
Strict JSON UTF8, unique keys, finite numbers, depth128/node500000 bounds. Inner bytes are never reserialized.
Strict canonical base64 validation uses linear scan, including multiMB inputs.
Native client capability probe requires rejection of trailing bytes and concatenated zlib members before opt-in.
20MiB decoded request and wire; existing canonical ChatJobs 20MiB guard reapplied after decode. Attachment endpoints/limits unchanged.
Page bound33816576 bytes is a separate transport bound; existing result cursor/events limits retained. No whole SSE response buffering.
Full envelope including base64/manifest must save max(1024 bytes,ceil(5% original)); otherwise identity.
Only local pre-send compression failures may fall back. No automatic retry after send, HTTP refusal, or uncertain return.
Hash detects byte corruption, not sender authentication. Account generation comes from existing authenticated server context.
limitations: Real execution uses Node native Web APIs, not Safari/Chrome device validation. Runtime adapters remain uninstalled.
Same-binding replay is not banned by a stateless codec: existing canonical request-id digest handles idempotency. Cross-binding/account/cursor substitutions are rejected.
No luminidic atom or scientific performance assertion.
